scope: CloakPDF Ask PDF conversation, indexing, citations and recovery
changes: Air reading panel, single-contour labelled composer and neutral conversation hierarchy
Actual page/passage progress, explicit preparation retry and no-readable-text recovery
Source-page links open the original local PDF; URLs revoked on replacement/unmount
Synchronous duplicate-send guard, preserved next draft and partial answer, retry returns focus
Document-scoped indexing, obsolete-result guards and interrupt on replacement/navigation
Instant token following stops when the reader scrolls away; keyboard-accessible Latest answer
Stable model-ready callback; safe markdown links, bounded tables/code and no remote image fetches

matrix.result: No page/workspace/log horizontal overflow or undersized controls; long code/tables scroll within their own regions

features: Unknown progress has no invented ratio; text/OCR/embedding progress uses actual stage units
Index errors do not loop; explicit retry restores composer/recovery focus
IME Enter is ignored; Shift+Enter and 500-character limit retained
Enter while answering neither appends an orphan turn nor clears the next draft
Failed answer retains partial text; retry uses its original question and preserves the draft
Citation links have unique positive page numbers and serve byte-identical source PDFs
Markdown refuses unsafe URLs and never embeds external images
Streaming follows new text without scrolling the outer page, preserves reader position and supports jump to latest
Replacing a file or navigating away interrupts generation and isolates late index/tokens/results
Reduced motion and forced-colour focus remain functional
manualReview: Desktop/laptop/tablet/mobile light/dark, input focus and table wrapping
Native Safari and Firefox: Enter submission, Shift+Enter multiline editing and actual 200% zoom
Safari citation opens the original two-page PDF in a new tab; source tab retained

removed: Unused InfoCallout component and its centre modifier
Weighted 30/70 progress helper and obsolete model/context comments
Old mono/uppercase/tinted transcript and composer skins
Per-token smooth scrolling and destructive error clearing
cleanup.remainingLegacy: Base notice styles still serve FindActTool and RedactTool; migration stays on the editor TODO.

limitations: Physical touch/software keyboard, real OS IME and assistive speech acceptance remain open; validated stays false
Native browser visual/keyboard checks use deterministic synthetic answers; actual model behavior is validated separately in Chromium
Indexing cannot abort underlying extraction/embedding yet; changing file discards obsolete work/results rather than reporting cancelled processing
This slice does not complete the editor or family refresh
next: Editor header, tool rail/search, properties panel, page navigation and thumbnails, followed by canvas and every panel/overlay
